title: Lox meat pie

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lox meat pie is a Plains-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Unbaked lox pie is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 2 Cloudberries
• 2 Lox meat
• 4 Barley flour
Lox meat pie is produced by cooking Unbaked lox pie in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Lox meat pie provides the second-highest health gain in the Plains at 75, second to Serpent stew, which provides 80

Introduction. Lox meat pie is a Plains-tier food.

Recipe. Unbaked lox pie is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 2 Cloudberries
• 2 Lox meat

Lox meat pie is produced by cooking Unbaked lox pie in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.
